answers.core: Making it an add-on would then require checking and casting everything that came from core. I'm doing it now and it is a little cumbersome.
answers.workaround: Currently, to do a proper `ToString` and `System.Enum.IsDefined` and stuff, I found it easiest to just define my own separate enum that I cast to first. For IsDefined to work properly, my custom enums also leaves out `AxisMax` and `ButtonMax`, (though that may be a separate proposal?)

title: Create separate enums for Joypad Buttons and Joypad Axes
